title: A Christmas Eve gift of song … that will carry you to New Years Eve and beyond.

body:
I’m so grateful for this sweet and simple rendition of Silent Night from Ryan and Kari – available here:

 https://www.ryanleesharp.com/blog/2018/11/24/the-hazelwood-sessions

  

 Thanks, Ryan and Kari. Something this honest and unpretentious is just what we need this year. And these hymns propel us well into next year too. Thank you.
